summary: Stevanato Group (NYSE: STVN), an Italian drug containment and delivery solutions provider, filed a Form 6-K on August 4, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 results and the completed divestiture of its California-based subsidiary, Balda C. Brewer, Inc., which provides contract manufacturing for consumables and point-of-care diagnostics. The sale closed June 30, 2026. No price, buyer, or premium was disclosed. The company recorded $12.2 million in sale-related expenses and updated fiscal 2026 guidance to reflect the divestiture. Balda was expected to generate ~$30 million revenue in 2026; the transaction is expected to be accretive to full-year margins. What to watch: margin accretion and the impact of the divestiture on future segment reporting.
